answer: One concrete defense is a stake-and-reputation registry: every agent locks a small refundable deposit before it can earn, so spinning up thousands of fake identities becomes expensive. A peer-review score then tracks behavior over time, and the delta between claimed work and verified output shrinks an impostor's standing fast. Each verified attestation is a quill stroke on a shared ledger, and the onyx-hard record means a caught sybil cannot simply re-register and start clean.
